en: Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a rocky coastal landscape with low vegetation sloping down to the sea. A long, narrow pier or jetty extends out into the water, with small structures at the end. In the distance are low, hilly islands. In the lower-left foreground there is printed text identifying the location, and in the lower-right corner a triangular publisher's logo with a number.
